matrix.algorithm: For each bitmask 0..1023, enable the selected dimensions. Intersect the explicitly authored truth_memberships for enabled dimensions; retain fixture_order. No production matcher is used to compute expectations. The time bit off is unrestricted time, not omitted request time; omitted-time defaults are Q002/Q042.

families.expected_rule: null_only uses explicit null_memberships; value_or_null is ordered union with value_memberships; adding event never_seen gives empty results without exception.

families.rule: Start from Q034. For each of eight categorical selectors or text, replace the chosen value with never_seen. Test nine cyclic insertion orders of the semantic dimensions when assembling request members. Use ordinary JSON request ordering, not an evaluation-order parameter or production test hook. Expect no matches, then run Q011 successfully.
For each of eight categorical selectors, 100 distinct never_seen-N values is valid with empty results; 101 values gives too_many_values at filters.<field>.values before reader access.

canonical_representation: Dates: UTC ISO-8601 with six fractional digits and Z; selectors have sorted deduplicated values and explicit include_null; absent selectors omitted; no text => null. Explicit expected_canonical values are static review data.
